Scope, from #140 runs 1-2 (transcripts ~/.worktrees/chatbot/transcripts/ticket-140-*):
(A) runner: review_prompt drops instruction[:2000] cut; prompts go to the CLI on stdin where the provider reads it (claude -p, codex exec), lifting the 128 KiB argv cap, so DIFF_LIMIT can grow; argv stays for agy/grok.
(B) runner: a worker line `NEED_PATH: <repo path> — <why>` does not burn a round: the run stops as phase=needs_path (branch kept, lease released), the card shows the request; the operator's OK a

(B) also needs the card UI and its route: static/app-evolution.js (show NEED_PATH request, [경로 허용] button) and the server route calling delegation's add-path action. Host modules change (delegation.py, server.py) -> ⚡소생 after landing.
